service.en: Medical fitness examination for residency visa
service.ur: رہائشی ویزا کے لیے طبی فٹنس معائنہ

about: Take the medical fitness test needed for a residence visa.
note: Requirements read from the official EHS service page on the checked date. EHS fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Medical fitness examination for residency visa. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Residents aged 18 and over with a valid Emirates ID or passport
documents: Valid Emirates ID or valid passport
fees: AED 250 for employees, companies and workers
AED 350 for private drivers, nursery supervisors and domestic help
AED 300 for beauty, gym, barber and health facility workers
